# Beta 1.0.1 · October 2026

## New things you can do
- Updates now come to you on their own. Settings, Updates shows when a new version is ready.
- Settings opens with ⌘, (Command-comma).

## Things that behave better
- If Brevier can't reach the update site, it now says it couldn't check, instead of "No updates yet."
- Agent names show the way you wrote them.
- Buttons show the pointing hand.
- Brevier Server's window opens tall enough to show Updates.
- The disk image window shows the whole picture.
